style_image.prompt:
Repaint this exact creature from the reference board, Cannonback the massive shell-sentinel water turtle, keeping its heavy fortress body, tall stacked rock-plate shell and bronze cannons, as ONE image: a single front three-quarter view of the whole body standing on four thick legs, centred, full body visible, on a plain flat light-grey studio background. Soft even studio lighting, no strong highlights, no cast shadows, no water, no splash, no scenery, no text. Stylised 3D game-character render with hand-painted textures: clean, large readable colour blocks with only subtle surface detail, no speckle, no noise, no grime.
Materials exactly as follows:
- Shell: chunky blue-slate stone plates (dusty slate blue, #52729a) with olive moss (#6f7436) packed into the seams between plates; every plate edge has a clear thin pale cream rim (#eadfc4). Blue-grey stone, NOT warm tan or brown.
- Water cannons: lighter weathered bronze (#b8a070 with soft grey-green weathering), dark inner bores.
- Legs, neck, head and tail: large clean blue scales (ocean blue #2e5886) over cream skin (#e9dcc0) like the reference, NO green spots.
- Belly plastron and throat: soft pale cream (#eadfc4), NOT saturated yellow, NOT pink.
- Face: warm cream jaw and lower face (#e6d4b2), a heavy rounded turtle jaw, not a white beak; clearly visible amber-gold eye (#d89a2a iris, dark pupil) under a blue scaled brow.
- Claws: cream-ivory.
Absolutely no red, pink, maroon, coral or oxblood anywhere.
